name: github
description: Full GitHub platform access through the official github-mcp-server container — read and write repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning, projects, discussions, gists, notifications, orgs, and users.

interface.shortDescription: Drive GitHub through the official github-mcp-server container.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work directly with your GitHub repositories — browsing code, creating issues, reviewing pull requests, running Actions workflows, and checking Dependabot alerts. No more context-switching between your chat and the GitHub tab. Just ask your agent to open a PR, check the CI status, review code changes, or find that issue you were tagged in. Everything happens through natural language, with full access to your repos.
defaultPrompt: Show me the open issues and pull requests in my repository.
Check the status of my CI workflow and any failing tests.
Create a new issue or pull request for this feature I'm working on.
